t: Ideal King Bomb strategies? :: FINAL FANTASY XII THE ZODIAC AGE General Discussions
s: According to FF Wiki, King Bomb casts Renew only twice, so you can simply keep fighting it until it no longer heals and runs out of HP. Nihopalaoa would have been handy, of course, but I didn't get it until the endgame. It’s really only practical to get it once Giruvegan opens up, as Leo gems are few and far between until that and the cerobi steppe are available. Guessing this was intentional because you could buy it so early from the clan provisioner in the original and cheese your way through most of the early/mid-game hunts with it.

t: King Bomb - Super Mario Wiki, the Mario encyclopedia
s: August 13, 2025 - King Bomb is a giant Bob-omb in Super Mario RPG: Legend of the Seven Stars. It is first used by Punchinello in a last-ditch effort to destroy Mario, Mallow, and Geno, but it only ends up crushing him and not even hurting Mario's party in its explosion. It can be battled later in the game as one of Wizakoopa's summons.

s: October 6, 2016 - The Bomb King is a medium range Damage Dealer. When playing him, you are going to want to stay out of direct combat, and toss bombs everywhere from a distance. Due to his already high base damage, he is a great candidate for the damage increase item you can buy during a match.
